task.name: pick_object_place_left_box_ep1
task.description: Use the right arm to grasp the object from the table and place it in the black box on the left.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the object on the table.
2. Grasp the object from the table.
3. Move the right arm to align with the black box on the left.
4. Release the gripper to place the object into the black box.
